assert.ok(evaluate(20, 0.1, "monthly") > 0)
assert.ok(usageQuote(30, 0.1, "monthly").amount > 0)
assert.ok(historySize() > 0)
assert.throws(() => evaluate(-1, 0.1, "monthly"), RangeError)
assert.ok(await subscriptionCharge(40) > 0)

usage:

evidence.reason: Left edit replaces metering.initialize() with metering.reset(), changes plan from "monthly" to "benchmark", and returns metering.historySize() instead of a charge value, altering the caller-visible contract.
Right edit adds an early return for units===0 before the negative-units RangeError check; this is behavior-preserving for the tested positive and negative inputs but changes the zero-input path.
Test asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0 and that evaluate(20, 0.1, "monthly") > 0; the left edit's "benchmark" plan and historySize() return may not satisfy the positive-charge expectation.

Relationship states evaluate value-references usageCharge; the left edit's new call to evaluate(units, 0.1, "benchmark") therefore routes through usageCharge, whose zero-guard from the right edit is the only supplied change.

result.userExplanation: 左侧改动把订阅计费改为重置计量、使用 benchmark 计划并返回历史大小，可能破坏订阅计费为正的测试与月度语义，而右侧仅新增零值提前返回，合并后行为存在实质不确定性。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/subscription.ts 的 subscriptionCharge 作者确认是否应保留 metering.initialize() 与 "monthly" 计划并返回计费值，而不是改为 metering.reset()、"benchmark" 和 metering.historySize()；同时请 src/metering.ts 的 usageCharge 作者确认 units===0 提前返回是否应放在负值校验之后。
